programme.title: Poszukiwacze klejnotów: Australia
programme.desc: To prawie koniec sezonu górniczego. Wody jest w bród, Max i Glenn mogą wreszcie odpocząć. Todd i Brianna potrzebują dużej ilości szafirów, aby przetrwać lato.

programme.title: Poszukiwacze klejnotów: Australia
programme.sub-title: S02 : E01 Poszukiwacze klejnotów: Australia S2 Ep1
programme.desc: Ekipa Old Timers kupiła nową działkę. Apprentices próbują połączyć szyb kopalniany ze swoją podziemną drogą dojazdową. Kids dogadują się z sąsiadami — czy jednak umowa okaże się opłacalna?

programme.title: Poszukiwacze klejnotów: Australia
programme.sub-title: S02 : E02 Poszukiwacze klejnotów: Australia S2 Ep2
programme.desc: Ekipa Bushies wraca z nadzieją, że tym razem pójdzie im lepiej. Richardsonowie sprawdzają, czy warto powrócić na starą działkę. Todd i Brianna robią, co mogą, aby utrzymać swój biznes na powierzchni.

programme.title: Poszukiwacze klejnotów: Australia
programme.sub-title: S02 : E03 Poszukiwacze klejnotów: Australia S2 Ep3
programme.desc: Mifsudowie proszą o pomoc swoje dzieci. Max i Glen walczą z awariami sprzętu, a Ray wreszcie znajduje na swojej nowej działce większe szafiry.

programme.title: Bohaterowie z St. John's
programme.desc: Wraz z rozpoczęciem długo wyczekiwanego sezonu na kraby setki łodzi wypływają w morze, a jeden z rybaków ma nadzieję ustanowić rekord świata.

programme.title: Za kratami: najcięższe więzienia na świecie
programme.sub-title: S05 : E01 Więzienie dla kobiet Sao Luis, Brazylia
programme.desc: W kompleksie więziennym Sao Luis w Brazylii kary odbywają najniebezpieczniejsze przestępczynie; większość z nich trafiła tu za czyny takie jak morderstwo, rozbój lub handel narkotykami.

programme.title: Za kratami: najcięższe więzienia na świecie
programme.sub-title: S05 : E02 Criminalista Geraldo Beltrao, Brazylia
programme.desc: Criminalista Geraldo Beltrão to więzienie o zaostrzonym rygorze, w którym przebywa około 200 osadzonych. Więźniowie mogą opuszczać swoje cele tylko na 15 minut dziennie.

programme.title: Za kratami: najcięższe więzienia na świecie
programme.desc: Więzienie o zaostrzonym rygorze Renovation 1 zostało zaprojektowane z myślą o maksymalnej kontroli i bezpieczeństwie; ucieczka stąd jest praktycznie niemożliwa.

programme.title: Za kratami: najcięższe więzienia na świecie
programme.sub-title: S05 : E04 Więzienie w Osace, Japonia
programme.desc: W więzieniu w Osace przebywa około 1100 osadzonych, z czego ponad 30 odbywa karę dożywotniego więzienia; osadzeni mogą rozmawiać tylko dwa razy dziennie przez pół godziny.

programme.title: Matylda Królowa Belgów
programme.desc: Badana psycholog jest figurą w dziedzinie zdrowia psychicznego i opieki nad dziećmi. Z Pałacu Królewskiego matka czwórki dzieci podjęła walkę z cyberprzemocą. "To jest nie do przyjęcia" to przesłanie Mathilde. Jako rzeczniczka Celów Zrównoważonego Rozwoju ONZ jest częścią globalnego ruchu. Dokument pokazuje kobietę, która jest blisko ludzi i która chce coś zmienić na świecie. Królowa z napiętym harmonogramem, która mimo to znalazła czas na ekskluzywne filmowanie.

programme.title: Diana - królowa ludzkich serc
programme.desc: Historia życia Diany, jej sławy, działalności charytatywnej oraz trwałego wpływu na cały świat.

programme.title: Mary Donaldson - sylwetka przyszłej królowej Danii
programme.desc: Prezentacja sylwetki Mary Donaldson, która w maju 2004 roku poślubia Jego Królewską Wysokość, Księcia Koronnego Danii Frederika - stając się tym samym członkinią jednej z najstarszych monarchii świata. Mary Donaldson zabiera nas z powrotem do Australii i jej rodzinnej Tasmanii, gdzie opowiada o swoim pochodzeniu kulturowym, wychowaniu - i o zakochaniu się w księciu i następcy tronu. Dokument śledzi również przygotowania Mary Donaldson do zostania "prawdziwą księżniczką".

programme.title: Posiadłości austriackich rodzin szlacheckich - Zamek Heidenreichstein - z wizytą u Netty Kinsky
programme.desc: Netty Kinsky opowiada historię zamku Heidenreichstein i swojej arystokratycznej rodziny na ORF III.

programme.title: Fryderyk X - Król Grenlandii
programme.desc: Król Frederik X i królowa Mary odwiedzają Grenlandię, wzmacniając więzi z Danią i jej mieszkańcami

programme.title: Królowa Elżbieta II
programme.desc: Królowa Elżbieta II jest najdłużej panującym monarchą w historii Wielkiej Brytanii i Wspólnoty Narodów. Jej służba dla kraju jest legendarna, a ona stała się globalną postacią siły, wytrzymałości i godności, z którą wszyscy się łączymy. Przeżyj triumfy, porażki, skandale i uroczystości i dowiedz się, jak młoda księżniczka stała się królową dla całego świata.

programme.desc: Od żebraka do cesarza dynastii Ming — Zhu buduje imperium inwigilacji, które brutalnie rozpada się od środka.

programme.title: Wygnany: życie po abdykacji
programme.desc: Gdy znika korona, zostają skandal, wygnanie i pytanie: kim jesteś bez władzy?

programme.title: Ostatnia dynastia królewska Portugalii
programme.desc: Od imperium po wygnanie — odkryj Braganzów: ostatnią królewską dynastię Portugalii, która rządziła na wielu kontynentach.

programme.title: Z Mekki do Jordanii: Upadek i Odrodzenie Dynastii
programme.desc: Haszymidzi stracili Mekkę i zamienili Jordanię w siłę.

programme.title: William i ciężar Korony
programme.desc: William i Catherine pod presją: żałoba, choroba i pytanie, czy Korona przetrwa XXI wiek.

programme.title: Wersal: Upadek rodziny królewskiej
programme.desc: Wersal, Ludwik XVI i Maria Antonina: blask, pycha i upadek monarchii w cieniu rewolucji.

programme.title: Księżniczka Eleonora
programme.desc: Księżniczka Eleonora, przyszła królowa Hiszpanii, dorasta na oczach świata, łącząc tradycję z nowoczesnością. Ten dokument ukazuje jej życie od dzieciństwa po pierwsze oficjalne obowiązki, edukację oraz przygotowanie do roli monarchini. To opowieść o odpowiedzialności, oczekiwaniach i wyzwaniach, jakie niesie ze sobą dziedzictwo hiszpańskiej korony.

programme.title: Żyjąc Przeszłością Przyszłości
programme.desc: Ten film podważa nasz sposób myślenia i zapewnia oryginalny wgląd w nasze podświadome motywacje, niezamierzone konsekwencje i sposób, w jaki nasza podstawowa natura wpływa na naszą przyszłość jako ludzkości.

programme.title: Skorumpowany Przemysł Spożywczy
programme.desc: laczego szynka jest różowa? Dlaczego uważamy, że jest dobra dla naszych dzieci? Dlaczego etykiety produktów są niezrozumiałe? Giganci przemysłowi są w stanie wstrzymać i ukierunkować decyzje polityczne bezpośrednio wpływające na zdrowie publiczne.

programme.title: Kakao - walka Zachodniej Afryki o uczciwe ceny
programme.desc: Na całym świecie około 5 milionów rolników produkuje ziarna kakaowe, codziennie odczuwając skutki światowych cen surowego kakao. Duże korporacje kontrolują ceny na rynku afrykańskim, utrzymując je na niskim poziomie. W 2020 roku Wybrzeże Kości Słoniowej wezwało do wprowadzenia regulowanej minimalnej ceny, a w 2022 roku UE zaostrzyła przepisy. Czy te działania przyniosą sprawiedliwe ceny dla Afryki Zachodniej?

programme.title: Co poszło nie tak w Kodaku
programme.desc: Kodak - ikoniczna marka osiągająca miliardowe przychody - w 2005 roku ogłosił bankructwo. Co poszło tak bardzo nie tak? Sekrety korporacyjne: lekcje z sali zarządu odsłania kulisy poprzez wywiady z osobami bezpośrednio zaangażowanymi. Dokument ujawnia decyzje i błędy, które doprowadziły do upadku tej legendarnej firmy.

programme.title: Gospodarka Jutra
programme.desc: Przyszłość jest niepewna i pełna wyzwań. Jak uratujemy nasze miasta i rozwiążemy problem nierówności? Jak poradzimy sobie z problemem starzejącego się społeczeństwa? Jak zniwelujemy różnice płacowe między płciami? Nadszedł czas zastanowić się nad przyszłością.

programme.title: Aborygeni: mroczny sekret Australii
programme.desc: UTOPIA to film ujawniający, że apartheid jest głęboko zakorzeniony w przeszłości i teraźniejszości Australii, a Aborygeni nadal żyją w skrajnym ubóstwie i warunkach jak w krajach trzeciego świata. Mają niską średnią długością życia i nieproporcjonalnie wysoki wskaźnik zgonów w aresztach policyjnych.

programme.title: Bitcoin: Poza bańką
programme.desc: Wraz z pojawieniem się Bitcoin, pierwszej na świecie waluty cyfrowej, po raz pierwszy w historii pieniądze nie są już kontrolowane przez banki lub rządy, ale przez ludzi, którzy ich używają.

programme.title: Norwegia i Samochody Elektryczne
programme.desc: Samochody elektryczne są w Norwegii bardzo popularne. Mimo, że powietrze w tym kraju jest mniej zanieczyszczone niż w innych krajach europejskich, Norwegowie wydobywają dużo ropy. Dlaczego więc tak bardzo inwestują w samochody elektryczne? Jakie są powody, które skłoniły ich do opracowania tego rodzaju samochodu?

programme.title: ASEAN Następne Pokolenie
programme.desc: 10 krajów, 640 milionów ludzi, łączna gospodarka tak duża jak Indie. ASEAN przygotowuje się na kolejne pokolenie.

programme.title: Jak Naprawić Firmę
programme.desc: Wiele firm przeszło przez długą fazę badań i testowania swoich produktów. Inwestorzy potrzebowali dużej siły przebicia, a ich modele biznesowe były narażone na gwałtowne wstrząsy na rynku. W tym filmie dokumentalnym przyjrzymy się bliżej niektórym z tych firm i ich drodze do sukcesu. Wiele z nich miało trudną drogę do osiągnięcia rentowności lub odzyskania konkurencyjności.

programme.title: Amerykańskie Państwo Nadzoru
programme.desc: Film ten analizuje obecny stan inwigilacji w Stanach Zjednoczonych. Czy prywatność jest przestarzałą fantazją? Czy mamy przyzwyczaić się do myśli, że ktoś nas ciągle obserwuje?

programme.title: Krupp - Mit i prawda
programme.desc: Historia rodziny Kruppów ukazuje dramatyczny rozwój niemieckiego przemysłu i ich prywatnych tragedii. Członkowie rodziny, choć szanowani, często umierali w samotności, poświęcając osobiste szczęście dla interesów firmy. W filmie odkrywane są nieznane fakty, a potomkowie rodziny opowiadają o jej cenie sukcesu i tragedii czterech pokoleń.

programme.title: Państwo na sprzedaż - skandal finansowy w Andorze
programme.desc: Jeśli nigdy nie słyszałeś o Andorze, teraz usłyszysz. Prywatny bank w Andorze został zniszczony przez rząd hiszpański, amerykański i andorski, aby unicestwić kataloński ruch niepodległościowy. Dziesiątki ludzi muszą iść do więzienia za przestępstwa, które nie istnieją, a dziesiątki niewinnych rodzin zostało okradzionych z ponad miliarda euro.

programme.title: Niechybny Koniec. Jak pieniądze straciły swoją wartość.
programme.desc: Wall Street jest okupowana. Europa wali się na siebie. Na całym świecie ludzie są ogarnięci strachem i gniewem, a jedno pytanie jest na ustach wszystkich: Czy kryzys finansowy się skończył, czy też zmierzamy w kierunku gospodarczej katastrofy? End of the Road to film dokumentalny, który jest kroniką globalnego krachu finansowego.

programme.title: Cienie i Blaski Mody
programme.desc: Wielkie nazwiska w modzie wybierają Chińczyków. Przybywają oni tutaj w coraz większej liczbie i mają znaczący wpływ na lokalną gospodarkę. Nasze badania nad Europą i Doliną Mody pokazują, że za kulisami stosuje się każdą sztuczkę, aby zwiększyć zyski - od luk podatkowych po system outsourcingu, w którym produkcja jest zlecana chińskim Włochom pracującym w niedopuszczalnych warunkach. Rozczarowane spojrzenie na wielkie marki.

programme.title: Ekonomia Południa
programme.desc: Australia, Nowa Zelandia i Chile strasznie słabo radzą sobie z technologią. Przez lata utalentowani programiści tych krajów uciekali do Doliny Krzemowej w USA, by tam zarabiać na życie. Ostatnie programy rządów Australii, Nowej Zelandii i Chile niedofinansowywały nauki i technologii. Istnieją jednak przesłanki by sądzić, że kraje te zaczęły zatrzymywać niektóre z rodzimych talentów technologicznych.

programme.title: 97% niczego
programme.desc: Dokument przedstawia poważne badania i weryfikowalne dowody dotyczące naszego systemu gospodarczego i finansowego.

programme.title: Jak narzucają nam styl życia
programme.desc: Życie to wybór. To, co jemy, co czytamy, kogo wybieramy; każdego dnia dokonujemy tysięcy wyborów, które określają jak chcemy żyć. A jeśli możliwość wyboru jest tylko iluzją?

programme.title: Niemieckie dynastie - Oetkerowie
programme.desc: Rodzina Oetkerów, jedna z najbogatszych niemieckich rodzin, przez dekady unikała mediów. Teraz, po raz pierwszy, jej członkowie przerywają milczenie i odkrywają burzliwe losy firmy i rodziny. Choć kojarzeni głównie z budyniem i proszkiem do pieczenia, ich historia skrywa mroczne sekrety, które zmieniły ich życie na zawsze.

programme.title: Chiny vs. USA
programme.desc: Chiny vs USA - Doświadczony dziennikarz John Pilger odsłania kulisy amerykańskiej strategii wobec Chin – setki baz wojskowych, ogromne floty oraz skutki działań, które mogą zaważyć na przyszłości świata. Film ujawnia przemilczane testy na Wyspach Marshalla, przedstawia inną perspektywę na historię Chin i pokazuje, dlaczego konflikt między USA a Chinami zagraża globalnej stabilności. To wnikliwy, rzetelnie udokumentowany dokument, który otwiera oczy.

programme.title: Magiczne Pieniądze - Rewolucja Bitcoina
programme.desc: Magiczne Pieniądze to film dokumentalny, który bada tajemnicze pochodzenie Bitcoina, jego rolę w społeczeństwie oraz to, w jaki sposób może on kształtować przyszłość naszego świata.

programme.title: Niechciani Turyści
programme.desc: Turystyka powoduje wzrost cen i brutalizację sklepów, restauracji i kultury w ogóle. W najczęściej odwiedzanych miastach Europy istnieją dzielnice, z których mieszkańcy są wypychani - turyści mogą płacić czynsze, na które nie stać miejscowych. Jest to szczególnie widoczne w Wenecji i Barcelonie, gdzie ludzie mobilizują się, by domagać się utrzymania turystyki w pewnych granicach.

programme.title: Gospodarka Północy
programme.desc: Co mają wspólnego Szwecja, Kanada i Islandia? Zgadza się, są położone wysoko na północy, gdzie panuje śnieg i jest zimno. Ale właśnie ten ekstremalny klimat dał początek całej gamie technologii i innowacyjnych pomysłów, bez których kraje takie jak Islandia i Szwecja nie byłyby konkurencyjne. Wybierz się z nami w podróż po gospodarce Północy.

programme.title: Zagrożenia Sztucznej Inteligencji
programme.desc: Analiza alternatywnego sposobu dokładnego badania opinii politycznych za pomocą programu sztucznej inteligencji o nazwie Polly.

programme.title: Dark Web - Boom na czarnym rynku
programme.desc: Internet ma swoją ciemną stronę, o której istnieniu prawdopodobnie nawet nie wiemy. Za pozytywną powłoką mediów społecznościowych, aplikacji komunikacyjnych i platform, które uczyniły nasze życie łatwiejszym i zbliżyły do siebie, znajdziemy przestępców wykorzystujących te same aplikacje i platformy do prowadzenia nielegalnych i niebezpiecznych działań.

programme.title: Niemieckie dynastie - Thyssenowie
programme.desc: Niemieckie dynastie: Thyssenowie - To mityczne już nazwisko. Kojarzy się nie tylko z ciężkim przemysłem, ale też z wytworną sztuką i niewyobrażalnym bogactwem z nią związanym.

programme.title: Giganci Techniki
programme.desc: Giganci Techniki w wersji z polskim lektorem. W tym dokumencie opowiadamy historie ludzi biznesu, którzy zmienili świat.

programme.title: Mea Culpa - Korupcja w Watykanie
programme.desc: Jest to najpoważniejszy skandal finansowy ostatnich 30 lat w Watykanie. Nie tylko ze względu na skalę ekonomiczną, ale także dlatego, że tym razem papież Franciszek postanowił nie patrzeć nikomu w twarz i polecił watykańskiemu wymiarowi sprawiedliwości postępowanie bez pobłażania. Śledztwo prowadzone przez promotorów sprawiedliwości (dotyczące zakupu budynku w Londynie) dotyka żółtego serca Watykanu, departamentu najbliższego papieżowi, czyli Sekretariatu Stanu. I sięga aż do Szwajcarii. W długim wywiadzie Enrico Crasso, syndyk z siedzibą w Lugano, który przez ponad dwadzieścia lat pracował jako zewnętrzny zarządca kasy Sekretariatu Stanu, a który teraz musi odpowiadać przed watykańskim wymiarem sprawiedliwości. Wraz z nim śledztwem objęta jest garstka finansistów i wysokich rangą prałatów, podejrzanych o realizację przestępczego planu mającego na celu splądrowanie kasy Stolicy Apostolskiej.

programme.title: Gospodarka Wschodu
programme.desc: Codziennie pojawiają się nowości z Doliny Krzemowej. Wiele naszych technologii pochodzi z "Think Tanks" świata zachodniego. Ale na Wschodzie także pojawiają się innowacje i postęp technologiczny. Czy to podróże kosmiczne w Rosji, czy pionierzy robotyki w Japonii, wszyscy oni próbują zdobyć innowacyjną przewagę konkurencyjną. Wybierz się z nami w podróż po gospodarczym Wschodzie.

programme.title: Gorący Pieniądz
programme.desc: Film dokumentalny o finansach w wersji z polskim lektorem

programme.title: Zmierzch Yakuzy
programme.desc: Czym jest Yakuza? Czy to rak narodu czy zło konieczne w kraju o jednym z najniższych wskaźników przestępczości w uprzemysłowionym świecie?

programme.title: Największe niemieckie klasy - historia firmy C&A
programme.desc: Wielkie niemieckie klany - historia C&A. Firma ma ponad 456 sklepów. Znajdziemy je w każdym większym niemieckim mieście. Aż 98% Niemców zna tę markę.

programme.title: Modowi Giganci
programme.desc: Dokument przedstawia sylwetki wybitnych postaci przemysłu modowego i finansowe aspekty tegoż biznesu.

programme.title: Gospodarka Zachodu
programme.desc: Na zachodzie znajdziemy jednych z największych lub przynajmniej najbardziej ekscentrycznych wynalazców świata. To rzemiosło jest seksowną bestią popychającą maszyny do granic możliwości. Jeśli spojrzeć na pustynię Mojave w USA lub Wielką Brytanię z czasów drugiej wojny światowej, to są to miejsca, które pławią się w inżynierskiej pasji i oferują wolność niestrudzonym majsterkowiczom.

programme.title: Kto Rządzi Ameryką
programme.desc: Polityczny film dokumentalny w wersji z polskim lektorem

programme.title: Token - przyszłość systemu ekonomicznego
programme.desc: Świat finansów podlega ciągłym zmianom. Wraz z postępem cyfryzacji w XXI wieku proces ten gwałtownie przyspieszył i otworzył nowe możliwości myślenia o finansach.

programme.title: Dilerzy: pierwszy kartel narkotykowy Ameryki
programme.desc: Dokument Setha Ferrantiego, byłego więźnia i filmowca, odsłania historię pierwszych karteli narkotykowych w USA – od czasów prohibicji po narodziny wojny z narkotykami. To fascynująca podróż przez mroczne korzenie amerykańskiego podziemia i jego wpływ na współczesne oblicze kraju.

programme.title: Eksperyment Bitcoin
programme.desc: Po globalnym kryzysie gospodarczym coraz więcej osób kwestionuje sposób funkcjonowania światowych rynków. Niektórzy zwracają się ku zdecentralizowanym systemom płatności, takim jak bitcoin, próbując odzyskać kontrolę nad gospodarką. Ale czym jest bitcoin?

programme.title: Pajęcza Sieć - Drugie Imperium Brytyjskie
programme.desc: Jak Wielka Brytania przekształciła się z największego imperium kolonialnego w nowoczesną potęgę finansową.

programme.title: Kto Rządzi Ameryką Part 2
programme.desc: Spojrzenie na tak zwany demokratyczny system rządzenia w Stanach Zjednoczonych Ameryki, ujawniający rzeczywiste siły, które rządzą narodem.

programme.title: Zeitgeist - Krok w przyszłość
programme.desc: Krok w przyszłość. Pełnometrażowy film dokumentalny w wersji z polskim lektorem. Film przedstawia argumenty za odejściem od obecnego społeczno-ekonomicznego paradygmatu monetarnego, który rządzi całym światem.

programme.title: Tajemnica potęgi Chin - Ep1
programme.desc: Odkryj niezwykłą ewolucję chińskiego krajobrazu miejskiego, gdy kraj rozpoczyna jeden z największych projektów urbanistycznych we współczesnej historii. W tym odsłaniającym wiele odcinku badamy, jak obszary wiejskie przekształcane są w nowoczesne metropolie zaprojektowane tak, by wspierać miliony ludzi – przy jednoczesnym uwzględnianiu kwestii środowiskowych i wyzwań społecznych.

programme.desc: W tym dokumencie opowiadamy historie założycieli największych firm internetowych.

programme.title: Endless Heavyness
programme.desc: Dive into pure power and unrelenting energy. Endless Heavyness is a non-stop wall of sound designed to hit hard and stay loud. No pauses, no compromises—just the most massive tracks to keep the momentum going. It’s not just loud; it’s eternal.

programme.title: From The Scene For The Scene
programme.desc: Go beyond the music and into the heart of the underground. This collection pairs heavy-hitting videos with exclusive band interviews and reports from metal capitals worldwide. Built by the scene, for the scene.

programme.title: Black Metal Ceremony
programme.desc: Immerse yourself in darkness with this collection of raw, atmospheric black metal. From blistering tremolo riffs to unholy vocals, this playlist evokes ancient rituals and nocturnal desolation. Enter the abyss and join the ceremony.

programme.title: Alternative Metal Paths
programme.desc: Break free from tradition with heavy riffs, crushing grooves, and genre-bending experiments. This collection showcases the boldest voices bridging alt-rock, grunge, and heavy metal into unvarnished, emotionally charged anthems.

programme.title: Heavy Pumping
programme.desc: Ditch the pre-workout and let the riffs do the heavy lifting. This high-octane blast of speed and power is designed to fuel your gains or ignite a living room mosh pit. High BPMs, crushing drums, and zero excuses.

programme.title: Power Metal Journey
programme.desc: Embark on a heroic quest fueled by soaring vocals, blistering guitar solos, and triumphant symphonic melodies. This playlist delivers high-energy anthems, epic fantasy tales, and pure, unstoppable speed metal glory.

programme.title: Metal Detector
programme.desc: Look no further! This is the right place for everything heavy. Your quest has ended so, lean back, turn up that sound system to a solid 11 and enjoy the ride. You have been warned…

programme.title: Death Metal Blasts
programme.desc: Brace for pure sonic devastation! Featuring relentless blast beats, guttural vocals, and razor-sharp riffs, this collection captures the raw intensity and uncompromising brutality of death metal at its absolute peak. Prepare for impact!

programme.title: Right Up Your Alley
programme.desc: As you found your way to our sophisticated TV channel, these music videos should hopefully satisfy your need for cool new Metal- & Rock content. Enjoy and let your friends know! Remember, we’re in this together.

programme.title: Symphonic Metal Epicness
programme.desc: Grand orchestral arrangements meet crushing heavy metal in a majestic display of power. Featuring operatic vocals, sweeping strings, and cinematic soundscapes, this collection delivers pure, dramatic drama on an epic scale.

programme.title: New Rock And Metal Videos For You
programme.desc: Stay ahead of the curve with the freshest drops from the global underground. From world premieres to the latest studio masterpieces, we’ve gathered the newest sonic assaults in one place. If it’s loud and new, it’s here.

programme.title: Gothic Metal Gathering
programme.desc: Step into the shadows with haunting melodies, heavy melancholic riffs, and dramatic symphonic arrangements. A dark, romantic journey through deep sorrow, eerie beauty, and powerful gothic soundscapes.

programme.title: Night Time Metal
programme.desc: The sun is down, the filters are off, and the real chaos begins. Brace yourself for the raw, uncensored side of the scene too heavy for daylight. This is the unfiltered truth of the underground. Adult ears only.

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.sub-title: S02 : E12 The Art of Wood
programme.desc: It's time to celebrate the art of smoking with wood! You'll drool over Spencer's Cherrywood Smoked Chicken Wings, dry rubbed with his favourite spices and smoked with cherrywood. Next, Spencer marinates sable fish in Japanese ingredients and grills it on a sweet-smoky cedar plank. Then, Spencer shows off his Texas BBQ skills with his Mesquite Smoked Skirt Steak. Engulfed in a thick cloud of white smoke, this skirt steak has the flavour and texture of tasty brisket, but made in a fraction amount of time. Finally, Spencer gives a pork shoulder a long, smoky cook in oak wood. The wait is worth it as he serves it piled high on a bun and topped with a mustardy Carolina BBQ sauce.

programme.title: Cook the Books

programme.desc: Chef-host Shahir Massoud tries out recipes from A Feast of Thorns and Roses: The Unofficial Cookbook of A Court of Thorns and Roses by Chelsea Cole! Follow along as Shahir prepares stuffed chicken with a berry reduction and puff pastry stars, melon caprese with a lemon basil vinaigrette, and jasmine and blackberry panna cotta!

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Home to popular Italian dishes like Tiramisu, Chef Michael Bonacini explores cuisine from Italy's Veneto region.

programme.title: Flour Power
programme.desc: Warm host Jessica McGovern offers up some do-it-yourself recipes that will spice up any wedding.

programme.title: Flour Power

programme.title: Flour Power
programme.desc: Picnics are fun, elegant, and filled with delicious food! Host Jessica McGovern shows us some of her favourite picnic-ready desserts.

programme.title: Flour Power
programme.desc: Host Jessica McGovern shows us how to make delightful breakfast treats like banana bread and hand pies filled with grape jelly.

programme.title: VEGANnotvegan
programme.desc: Maddy and Kiki put a fresh spin on a beloved brunch staple, with homemade lox and bagels facing off against smoky carrot lox and high-protein bagels, all piled high with creamy spreads and classic toppings for a seriously satisfying spread.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: The popular region of Tuscany is known for its wines, cheeses, and gorgeous sights. Chef Michael Bonacini introduces us to Tuscany's fine cuisine with four of his favourite dishes. Michael draws attention to the importance of mushrooms in Tuscan culture with an antipasto: Many Mushroom soup. Warm, hearty, and full of earthy flavour, Michael tops this soup with fried sage leaves to combine comfort and crunch in a single bite. For his primo, Michael explores a Tuscan favourite - Lamb Ragu! Served over pici noodles, Michael's rich ragu is complemented by fresh, light herbs. Then, Michael serves up a Porchetta-Style Duck, a crispy and tender secondo. To bring his meal together, Michael ends with a smooth and decadent Creamy Coffee Custard any coffee fan will appreciate.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: From hearty inland crops to fresh food of the sea, the Venetian region covers it all. Host Michael Bonacini begins with the sea as he serves up an antipasto of succulent Soft Shell Crab. Michael pairs the crab with a Tangy Aioli made from sundried tomatoes, creating the perfect combination of crispy and creamy. Moving inland for his primo, Michael twists together two classic Venetian dishes to make a new favourite: Radicchio Risotto! With his secondo, Michael cooks up a light and creamy Pancetta-Wrapper Snapper with Pea Mash. Sweet and tender, this dish will melt in your mouth. Whether you're in the mood to share or feeling a little selfish, Michael's Giant Almond Crumb Biscuit covers it all. Buttery, sweet, and satisfyingly crumbly, this biscuit is sure to lead to a memorable dinner!

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Puglia's lush landscape and large coastline characterize its cuisine. Chef Michael Bonacini explores its native ingredients through some of Puglia's favourite meals. First up, Michael's antipasto is a guaranteed crunchy bite with crispy Fried Mussels. Stepping away from the sea, Michael highlights Puglia's prize crop: tomatoes! Combining colourful tomatoes with flavourful burrata cheese, Michael cooks up comfort in a bowl with his Tomato and Burrata Risotto. Taking on a more festive flair, Michael introduces us to Little Pork Bombs, the hottest street food in Puglia. With a filling of fresh herbs and melted cheese, these pork skewers are savoury and irresistible. Then, Michael introduces a classic Father's Day dessert for his dulce: Sour Cherry-on-Top Fritters. A dessert for strolling the street, Michal's crispy golden fritters topped with light mascarpone whipped cream will have you whipping them up at home as well!

programme.title: Griddle Nation
programme.sub-title: S01 : E27 Elevated Eats: Gourmet on the Griddle
programme.desc: Fine dining meets flat-top finesse. Discover how classic ingredients and refined techniques transform into elegant, restaurant-worthy dishes, proving the griddle is a tool for true culinary artistry.

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.sub-title: S02 : E12 The Art of Wood
programme.desc: It's time to celebrate the art of smoking with wood! You'll drool over Spencer's Cherrywood Smoked Chicken Wings, dry rubbed with his favourite spices and smoked with cherrywood. Next, Spencer marinates sable fish in Japanese ingredients and grills it on a sweet-smoky cedar plank. Then, Spencer shows off his Texas BBQ skills with his Mesquite Smoked Skirt Steak. Engulfed in a thick cloud of white smoke, this skirt steak has the flavour and texture of tasty brisket, but made in a fraction amount of time. Finally, Spencer gives a pork shoulder a long, smoky cook in oak wood. The wait is worth it as he serves it piled high on a bun and topped with a mustardy Carolina BBQ sauce.

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.sub-title: S01 : E09 Grilled Cheese and Tomato Soup
programme.desc: The ultimate childhood comfort food, Grilled Cheese and Tomato Soup! Missy Hui takes this dish up with a basil- infused tomato soup that's ubERS-creamy and fresh! Don't forget the grilled cheese - gooey Havarti, provolone, and cheddar ooze out of this sandwich for an ultra-indulgent dish. Tiera Singh's twist on toast and tomatoes? Panzanella Salad! Ripe, seasonal tomatoes are tossed with a tangy capERS-vinegar dressing that is soaked up by crunchy croutons. Going higher? Micah Trainor's Seared Halloumi and Glazed Fruit grills the cheese - no bread needed! Seared halloumi is topped with bourbon-glazed fruit for a savoury-sweet vegetarian dish. Poppy Sandler's Lobster Roll with Sweet Corn Bisque brings back the soup and sammie - Up the Dish style. Roasted corn cobs add a complex note, and homemade jalapeno mayo brings the spice!

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: Up the Dish host Micah Trainor tries her hand at an Italian original - Veal Piccata! Lemony, buttery, capERS-y veal melts in the mouth after being pounded supERS-thin and seared to perfection. Poppy Sandler's sideways switch-up is a Caper Almond Crusted Halibut, sizzled and baked until gorgeously golden-brown and flaky, then garnished with chives and pea shoots. Next, Missy Hui goes Greek with her vegetarian Avgolemono, a silky-smooth citrusy soup starring lemon and egg, garnished with orzo and shimeji mushrooms. Tiera Singh ties it all together with her Sumac Veal Sweetbreads with a rough chopped caperberry-olive tapenade - browned veal sweetbreads are sprinkled with tart sumac and laid on a bed of tapenade, then drizzled with a sweet 'n' sour pomegranate molasses vinaigrette.

programme.title: The Wizard Of Sauce
programme.desc: Chef Kyle Crawford pulls back the curtain on wine sauces! First up, a classic veal marsala! Next, a white wine chicken gravy and a port sabayon with grapes!

programme.title: Feed My Soul, V!
programme.desc: Vanessa plans an autumn-themed menu with a table to match! There's blood orange and broccolini salad, butternut squash mac ‘n’ cheese, cranberry-rosemary chicken thighs, sheet pan curried cauliflower, and so much more!

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: In this bacon loving episode, Chef Spencer delivers a tasty Bacon Weave Turkey Breast, which gets injected with beer and spices before being wrapped up in its cozy bacon blanket and sent off to the grill! Next up? A Peameal Bacon Roast with Rosti. This heavy hunk of back bacon gets smoked to flavourful perfection while Chef Watts makes the crispiest golden-fried-to-perfection potato pancake. Then, Spencer whips up a charry, grilled, super decadent, bacon-wrapped and bacon stuffed cheeseburger. Spencer isn't finished with bacon yet! For his final recipe, Spencer stuffs an apple with decadent crispy morsels stuffed along with savoury caramelized onions and melty cheddar cheese.

programme.title: Spencer's Big 30
programme.desc: Host Spencer Watts makes Zucchini Noodles with Jumbo Turkey Meatballs for a healthy take on spaghetti night in around 30 minutes.

programme.title: Feed My Soul, V!
programme.desc: Vanessa plans a springtime menu with a table to match! There's fava beans and asparagus salad, lamb shoulder with artichokes and mint, sumac-lime green beans, deviled eggs, and so much more!

programme.title: VegHeadz
programme.desc: Fall favourites are on display as chef Pino Di Cerbo shares magic autumn dishes. Beginning with Brussels sprouts, Pino serves them both roasted and fresh over creamy labneh with a funky black garlic dressing. Then, for a twist on regular risotto, Pino combines barley and celery to create a dish that is creamy and comforting. Autumn keeps falling in the next dish, a salad of butternuts, kale and a vibrant vinaigrette bursting with apple and ginger. For his fall finale, Pino creates mushrooms on toast with roasted mixed mushrooms in a rich sauce paired with gremolata and served hot on toasted focaccia!

programme.title: Spencer's Big 30
programme.desc: Host Spencer Watts shows how you can make a delicious family-style roast beef dinner in about 30 minutes, for under 30 dollars.

programme.title: Flour Power
programme.desc: Host Jessica McGovern gives us a sweet taste of chocolate heaven with an overload of chocolatey desserts including a decadent Bombe au Chocolat.

programme.title: Spencer's Big 30
programme.sub-title: S02 : E07 Night at the Pub
programme.desc: It's pub night in Spencer Watts' kitchen! Forget going out - Spencer's pub recipes are bold in flavour and mild on the wallet!

programme.title: Cook the Books
programme.desc: Chef-host Shahir Massoud tries out recipes from another award-winning cookbook: Anna Olson’s Baking Wisdom! Follow along as Shahir makes a breakfast galette, a classic apple tart, a rich brown butter pecan pie, and much more!

programme.title: Gusto's QR Countdown
programme.desc: Unlock Gusto TV's top recipes on QR Countdown! Thousands of viewers scan our QR codes to access our delicious dishes. Now, we're serving up 8 of our most popular cornbread recipes, from hosts like Natalia Machado and Spencer Watts.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Renowned Chef Michael Bonacini takes viewers on a culinary tour of the Italian region of Trentino-Alto Adige without leaving his own kitchen.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Charming host Chef Michael Bonacini explores the mountainous region of Basilicata with a feast fit for any celebration. Beginning with an antipasto that caters to the region's southern heat, Michael stuffs crunchy sweet peppers with ripe tomatoes, savoury anchovies, and fresh oregano. Moving on to the primo, Michael cooks up a creamy Vermicelli Frittata. Using leftover pasta, he combines eggs with cheese, anchovies, and chili flakes for extra flavour to make a classic Basilicata dish. Michael cooks up Pollo Alla Potentina, a traditional meal from the Feast of Saint Gerard. This hearty chicken stew is sure to heat up your core, using hot peppers as the base of the meal. For his final dish, Michael combines the rich tastes of pomegranate, walnuts, and dark chocolate to create his unique Sweet Wheat Bowl.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini highlights the tiny region of Molise, exposing some of its best kept savoury secrets. Starting with a classic, Michael cooks up a delicious multi-layered Chicory Timbale, a pie filled with fresh chicory, ripe roma tomatoes, and sliced prosciutto. To crisp up the top of the pie, Michael tops his delicious dish with finely grated pecorino cheese and crunchy breadcrumbs. Next up, Michael's primo is a spicy Octopus in Purgatory. This tender, colourful, and sumptuous dish is sure to impress in both looks and taste! For his secondo, Michael cooks up a traditional Marinated Rabbit. Stewed in wine, tomatoes, and chilies, this rustic dish will have your guests asking for seconds. To finish, Michael whips up light and luscious Peaches and Cream Cookies. Filled with decadent cream, these round delights are refreshing and lighter-than-air - the perfect way to end a wholesome meal.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Delving into the cold mountainous region of Valle D'Aosta, Celebrity chef Michael Bonacini whips up a meal of four hearty dishes that are sure to warm up any chilly day. First up is Michael's antipasto of Wild Mushrooms and Lardo on Rye. Coated with rich, earthy mushrooms, buttery fontina cheese, and savoury cured pork, this decadent dish highlights a combination of iconic flavours from Valle D'Aosta. Next up is a twist on traditional pasta with Valle D'Aosta's unique Chestnut Fettucine topped with Sweet Pork and Earthy Cabbage. The secret to this dish? Chestnut flour to create a denser, sweeter, and nuttier pasta. For his secondo, Michael turns to the pride of the region, Fontina cheese, to fill his Stuffed Veal Cutlets. Luscious and rich, this dish is a burst of luxurious flavours in every bite. For his final dish, Michael shows his sweet side with a Crema di Cogne served with Valdostana Tile Cookies. The thin, crispy cookies with a hint of hazelnut dipped in a light chocolate cream are the perfect way to wrap up Michael's luxurious Valle D'Aosta meal.

programme.title: Holiday Eatz
programme.desc: Get your 'Gobble Gobble' on with this special episode of Holiday Eatz, featuring fun and charming host Kimberly Lallouz! She starts her terrific Turkey Day menu with a harvest happy Kale Salad heaped with beets, candied pecans, toasted lentils, and goat cheese. Thanksgiving dinner needs Hot Rolls, Chef Lallouz packs hers with cranberries and corn, then serves them as a standalone course with a cheesy, creamy Mushroom Fondue! Next, it's time to talk turkey with a trick that cuts your poultry cooking time in half! Her Spatchcock Turkey is not just faster than old school, it's yummier too, with a garlic-herb marinade and a unique side of mixed beans and rice! Candied sweet potatoes and marshmallows make their perennial appearance here, but Chef Kimberly has a version that will fry"... your brain! Check out her Sweet Potato Churros with Marshmallow Creme for a presentation you"... do-nut"... want to miss!

programme.title: Spencer's Holiday BBQ
programme.desc: Join charismatic chef Spencer Watts at his glorious rooftop patio for a one-hour special featuring a full holiday spread, all made on the BBQ. Spencer’s festive menu is all about creative BBQ twists with his delectable, mouth-watering recipes including Burnt Orange Cranberry Marmalade, Maple Rye Pumpkin Pie, and Asparagus with Smoked Salmon Dip. Save room for the piece de Q-sistance: Smoked Turkey Two Ways. This year, take your holiday feast outside and serve up something deliciously different.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Simplicity is key with Sicilian cuisine and Chef Michael Bonacini explores just how the region balances simplicity with intensity through four flavourful dishes. Starting with an antipasto of Folded Flatbread with Ricotta and Fennel Seeds, Michael inspires with its intricate beauty with a simple recipe. Keeping to the theme of simplicity, Michael shows that plenty of flavour can come from little ingredients in his primo of Broccoli and Sausage Rigatoni. The spicy sausage and chili is countered by a creamy broccoli pesto for a dish that highlights Sicilian cuisine. Michael turns to the Italian queen of crops for his secondo: Eggplant Parmesan Roll-Ups. With thin slices of eggplant rolled up to contain a mouth-watering mixture of mozzarella, provolone, and pecorino romano, this dish gets an extra kick of flavour from a coating of breadcrumbs and tomato sauce. To bring it all together, Michael combines spicy with sweet through his tender Spiced Chocolate Cookies.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Filled with ruins in its bustling streets, the region of Lazio sticks with grandeur in all it does, including food! To introduce us to Lazio, Host Michael Bonacini highlights its Jewish influence with a crispy Roman Jewish-style Artichokes. As crunchy as a potato chip, Michael's artichokes are a delicious fried treat that are a perfect way to kick off a delicious meal. For his primo Michael brings together simple ingredients to create a rich Bucatini with Amatriciana Sauce. Michael's secondo turns what was once peasant food into a delectable and tender dish. Cooked with a blend of vegetables and sauce, Michael's Braised Oxtail brings forth the history of cuisine. Returning to Rome for his final dish, Michael cooks up the popular Sour Cherry and Ricotta Tart. With the tart cherries countered by the creamy ricotta, every decadent bite offers a world of taste.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Campania's beautiful coastline is filled with two things: tourists and seafood. Diving into the culture of the region, Celebrity Chef Michael Bonacini begins his meal with a salad from the Island of Capri. Putting a twist on the classic dish, Michael's Grilled Caprese Salad combines fresh tomatoes, tangy balsamic, and a hint of sweetness from basil. For his primo, Michael serves up bold flavours with his Spaghetti Puttanesca. Mixing salty and sweet, this sauce offers a delicious take on the typical plate of spaghetti. Looking to the coast for his secondo, Michael quickly cooks up aromatic and spicy Herb-stuffed Scallops and Grilled Broccoli Rabe. For his dolce Michael whips up a dessert made for a celebration: Rum Babas. Typically for special occasions, each bite of Rum Babas offers pure sweetness with a fresh citrus zest.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini delves into the Italian region of Emilia- Romagna to discover its iconic cuisine. To start, Michael stays light with an airy Mortadella Mousse spread on fluffy Modena Mini Flatbreads. Next, Michael cooks up Tortellini in Broth, a dish originally from Bologna that can be easily altered to personal taste. Michael chooses to fill his tortellini with a rich and savoury mixture of prosciutto, mortadella, and ground pork. For his secondo, Michael uses traditional ingredients and pairs them in a tart, luxurious dish of Duck Breast with Balsamic Cherry Sauce. To wind down his meal, Michael whips up a creamy classic, Rice Custard Cake topped with a Cherry Glaze.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini explores sweet and spicy dishes hailing from the coastal region of Calabria. For his antipasto, Michael cooks up a light and refreshing Brioche with Gelato. Fluffy brioche buns surround the sweet flavours of gelato for a delicious start to your meal. Switching to spice for the primo, Michael introduces a Spicy Sausage and Ricotta Pasta. Full of sweet, savoury, and spicy flavours, this dish provides a strong, flavourful meal sure to please any crowd. For his secondo, Michael goes for a hearty Lamb au Gratin with Peas and Asparagus; a classic holiday dish that will warm any room. For his finale, Michael whips up a simple, yet impressive, Chocolate-covered Figs.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Full of luxurious treats, the northern Italian region of Lombardy offers rich and delicious cuisine. For his antipasto, celebrity chef Michael Bonacini prepares a delicate dish of Stuffed Squash Blossoms. Soft and light, these blossoms are enhanced with a creamy filling of parmesan, anchovies, and nutmeg. Following the fresh taste of flowers, Michael cooks up an impressive and rich Risotto Milanese. A feast for your eyes and taste buds, this risotto is coloured by saffron and its floral strands release flavour and colour as it's cooked. For his secondo Michael pairs a succulent Veal Roast with the sweet and sour Mustard Fruit to bring out a tangy delight. Michael's dolce looks solely at chocolate, creating a creamy and crunchy Chocolate Salami. Full of nuts, cookies, and creamy chocolate, this rich dessert is a wonderful way to finish off any meal.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Known for its lush landscape, Umbria is a region of that offers fresh, seasonal ingredients perfect for simple yet boldly flavoured cuisine. To begin his Umbrian feast, Chef Michael Bonacini serves up a sweet and spicy antipasto of Fried Spicy Tomato Flatbread. Seasoned with chili peppers for that bit of heat, Michael's antipasto is a humble yet satisfying snack. For his primo, Michael brings our attention to an Umbrian specialty: truffles! Prepared with light and fluffy pasta, Michael's Gnocchi with Black Truffle concentrates the decadent flavour of the truffle in the pillowy pasta to create a rich and delectable dish. Paying homage to the plights of farmers and fisherman, Michael's secondo combines the delicious flavours of land and sea. Michael's seasoned Seared Fish is paired with sweet and savoury lentils for a warm and homey dish. Finally, for Michael's dolce he bakes a warm and wintery Umbrian classic: Umbrian strudel.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Appreciating island culture, host Michael Bonacini explores the enchanting region of Sardegna and its exceptional cuisine. Michael begins his island feast with a taste of the sea through his seasoned antipasto of Stuffed Snails. Next, Michael prepares a luxurious and delicate Lobster Spaghetti, highlighting the fresh seafood of the region. Moving inland for his secondo, Michael cooks up a traditional dish of Lamb with Artichokes and Saffron, a meal that combines three of Sardegna's most famous ingredients. To end his meal, Michael combines salty and sweet with a dolce of Honey and Cheese Fritters.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: One of Italy's quieter regions, Friuli Venezia Guilia offers iconic decadent dishes, waiting to be discovered. Renowned chef Michael Bonacini begins his exploration of the region with his take on a traditional meal: Cheese Crisp Baskets with Polenta and Mushrooms. This savoury antipasto is an elegant looking dish with humble flavours. For his primo, Michael prepares a unique Poppy Seed, Sage, and Prosciutto Pasta, a dish that is a twist on traditional pasta. Looking for a little heat in his secondo, Michael cooks up a meal of Spicy Tomato Scampi. The sweet meat of the scampi counters the heat of the sauce, creating a delicious flavour combination. To end his meal, Michael looks to the region's Austrian influence by preparing his dolce of Apricot Sweet Buns. Soft, sweet, and light these buns are the perfect way to wrap up a Friuli Venezia Guilia meal.

Chestnut flour to create a denser, sweeter, and nuttier pasta. For his secondo, Michael turns to the pride of the region, Fontina cheese, to fill his Stuffed Veal Cutlets. Luscious and rich, this dish is a burst of luxurious flavours in every bite. For his final dish, Michael shows his sweet side with a Crema di Cogne served with Valdostana Tile Cookies. The thin, crispy cookies with a hint of hazelnut dipped in a light chocolate cream are the perfect way to wrap up Michael's luxurious Valle D'Aosta meal.

programme.title: Holiday Eatz
programme.desc: Get your 'Gobble Gobble' on with this special episode of Holiday Eatz, featuring fun and charming host Kimberly Lallouz! She starts her terrific Turkey Day menu with a harvest happy Kale Salad heaped with beets, candied pecans, toasted lentils, and goat cheese. Thanksgiving dinner needs Hot Rolls, Chef Lallouz packs hers with cranberries and corn, then serves them as a standalone course with a cheesy, creamy Mushroom Fondue! Next, it's time to talk turkey with a trick that cuts your poultry cooking time in half! Her Spatchcock Turkey is not just faster than old school, it's yummier too, with a garlic-herb marinade and a unique side of mixed beans and rice! Candied sweet potatoes and marshmallows make their perennial appearance here, but Chef Kimberly has a version that will fry"... your brain! Check out her Sweet Potato Churros with Marshmallow Creme for a presentation you"... do-nut"... want to miss!

programme.title: Spencer's Holiday BBQ
programme.desc: Join charismatic chef Spencer Watts at his glorious rooftop patio for a one-hour special featuring a full holiday spread, all made on the BBQ. Spencer’s festive menu is all about creative BBQ twists with his delectable, mouth-watering recipes including Burnt Orange Cranberry Marmalade, Maple Rye Pumpkin Pie, and Asparagus with Smoked Salmon Dip. Save room for the piece de Q-sistance: Smoked Turkey Two Ways. This year, take your holiday feast outside and serve up something deliciously different.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Simplicity is key with Sicilian cuisine and Chef Michael Bonacini explores just how the region balances simplicity with intensity through four flavourful dishes. Starting with an antipasto of Folded Flatbread with Ricotta and Fennel Seeds, Michael inspires with its intricate beauty with a simple recipe. Keeping to the theme of simplicity, Michael shows that plenty of flavour can come from little ingredients in his primo of Broccoli and Sausage Rigatoni. The spicy sausage and chili is countered by a creamy broccoli pesto for a dish that highlights Sicilian cuisine. Michael turns to the Italian queen of crops for his secondo: Eggplant Parmesan Roll-Ups. With thin slices of eggplant rolled up to contain a mouth-watering mixture of mozzarella, provolone, and pecorino romano, this dish gets an extra kick of flavour from a coating of breadcrumbs and tomato sauce. To bring it all together, Michael combines spicy with sweet through his tender Spiced Chocolate Cookies.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: In the ten years since they first met Avril and Andrew Wilson-Rankin have been dreaming of owning their own home. Now they've bought a property in Dun Laoghaire south county Dublin but it's as far from being a home, or even a house, as you could imagine.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Jean Robinson and Daithi Elliffe have bought themselves what they hope will be an ideal family home in a unique location - a listed 19th century former schoolhouse at Kilternan with spectacular views of the Dublin mountains, but all is not as it appears.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Struggling with a tight schedule, a limited budget and the traditionalist taste of his clients, can Dermot balance their love of classic farmhouse design with his own vision of clean urban functionality?

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: This week, Dermot wants to create a wheelchair friendly house in Malahide that's also a welcoming family home.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Sally-Ann, her husband Trevor, and their four children live in Sally-Ann's childhood home - a huge, distinctive 1970s architect-designed home outside Mullingar in Westmeath that they've dreamed of rennovating for years.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Since they married two years ago, Paul and Sabina Horgan have become the proud parents of baby Mia and the owners of a property on the North Dublin coast: Lismara - a dilapidated 1940s cottage in Portmarnock in an extremely poor condition.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: GP, writer and budding musician Dr Pat Harrold, his wife Marita, a physiotherapist, and their four kids returned to Pat's home town of Nenagh 10 years ago and they have been looking for a place to call home ever since.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Leonard and Caroline live in house once owned by Leonard's grandparents in the south Dublin suburb of Dundrum - a 1960s three-bed semi that hasn't changed at all since the couple bought it two years ago.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: At the village of Puckaun in north Tipperary, teachers Darragh Egan, his partner Sarah Lovett and their three month old son Donagh are moving home. What could be simpler or more straightforward? Well, as it turns out, quite a lot. Home is the 1960s bungalow where Darragh grew up - built on the site of the old village school by his late father Jim and currently occupied by his 70 year old mother.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Airline pilot Ian Callaghan has bought a 1930s Victorian house in his hometown of Drogheda, County Louth, which he and his girlfriend Claire Moore are keen to call home. Though full of charm and period features, the house is in dire need of renovation. Enter: architect Dermot Bannon with an innovative plan to retain the building's century-old ambience while adding a radical modern extension.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Last year, Aoife from Sutton and her wife Mel from New Zealand bought themselves a three bed semi in Baldoyle north Dublin - a tiny house in a spectacular bayside location. With incredible, unobstructed views of the sea and Portmarnock golf course, they've been hoping to renovate the house to suit its superb location ever since.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: This week Dermot is in Maynooth. Seven years ago, George and Sinead Mullis fell in love in with the Coach house - an 1850s building on half an acre of the historic former Carton Estate in Maynooth. In 2014, they bought the place for just half of its former asking price and moved in with their two year old son Daniel. But what seemed like their dream home soon turned out to be anything but.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: A special edition of the show where Dermot revisits three of his favourite builds from earlier series: the Longford publicans he convinced the embrace the void, a couple moving home from California to Bishopstown and 14 year old Michael's wheelchair accessible semi-d in Malahide.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Robbie and Julie from Darndale in North Dublin have saved for over 20 years to buy the house of their dreams - a 1940s cottage in the picturesque north Dublin suburb of Malahide. With a budget of 180K, Dermot's clients plan to gut the cottage, doubling its size with a spacious new two-storey extension to the rear, but the remediation costs are high.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Farmer and Boatbuilder Enda and his wife Mags live on a 55 acre Brussel Sprout farm at Balheary near Swords in North Dublin. After three decades of life in the country, they're moving back to Enda's home town - the picturesque seaside village of Rush. Their new home, formerly owned by Enda's aunt is an old fisherman's house near the harbour.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Moate in County Westmeath, is a place where football is part sport, part religion. On an overgrown plot on the outskirts of town lies the abandoned future home of county GAA All Star Dessie Dolan, his wife Kelly and their 3-year-old son Nathan. They have bought themselves a dilapidated cottage on a hopelessly exposed site in the village.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: At Sutton in North Dublin, Dermot extends a 1960s suburban house, changing a beloved childhood home into a sumptuous new one for Hannah, James and their twin sons. To give the couple the 'wow factor' they've asked for, Dermot designs a large L-shaped extension at the rear of the house with a soaring mezzanine level.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Having rented a house in Navan for the last two years, teacher Celine and sound engineer Dave are excited at the prospect of moving to a farmhouse once owned by her grandparents at Kildalkey village in County Meath where Celine grew up. The couple will be the fourth generation to live there and retaining the charm and character of the old place is a major concern for the whole family.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: In the three years since newlyweds Rosie and Keith bought their five-bed house in Templeogue, Dublin 6, they haven't changed a thing. From the dark, cold interiors to the cavity block, flat roofed extension, this house is a relic of 1970s design, with décor to match. Keen to create a unique take on the rather unimaginative suburban semi, Dermot designs a radical, steep-roofed extension...

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Country and Irish legend Daniel O'Donnell and his wife Majella share a large four bed detached home in Kincasslagh West Donegal. Unlike Daniel, who's fairly happy with the place, Majella is keen to upgrade and reconfigure the interior. With her husband on tour, she's determined to get the very best from her architect.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Nine years ago, Susie and Dave bought their dream home on the outskirts of Fermoy in Cork - a 170 year old three storey mansion that Susie has admired since she was a teenager. The house however, has begun to show its age and Susie and Dave want to extend and upgrade to create the ultimate family home.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: IT manager Christine has bought herself a red brick terraced house in Clontarf, North Dublin. And despite his best efforts, Dermot is unable to convince Christine to modify her 25 page wish list.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: At the seaside village of Portrane in North Dublin, Dermot creates a workable home for three generations of the one family under the watchful, budget-conscious eyes of two sisters.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Recently returned to Ireland after 12 years in London, new parents website designer Cliona and IT manager Micheal have already spent 30 grand renovating a 1950s semi-D at Killester in North Dublin in their own distinctive, industrial style.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Dairy farmer Padraig and schoolteacher Katie are hoping to create their 'forever' home by renovating a century-old farmhouse on a half acre of land recently inherited from Padraig's uncle. programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: At a 1960s 'Semi D' in Stillorgan, Dermot's vision of a million euro 'Malibu style' house for Rory and Lorna from the west of Ireland descends into an ongoing battle over the style and position of the front door.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: David and Nessa Conlon have just bought this 1990s split level detached bungalow and plan to move in with their three children (twin boys aged 11 and a 7 year old girl) once the renovations have been completed.

programme.desc: Luxurious hotels, thrilling water parks, inexpensive food and almost 300 days of bright sunny weather make Bulgaria’s biggest seaside resort, Sunny Beach popular for budget beach getaways. Catriona, however, stumbles onto the historic town of Nessebar, which is over 3000 years old, and realizes that there is more to the place than meets the eye. She goes on to visit the Castra Rubra winery, where she finds out about the history of Viticulture in Bulgaria and the process of wine making.

programme.title: Xplore Bulgaria
programme.desc: For the people of Sofia, preserving its heritage is sacrosanct, and this can be seen in the way the city's infrastructure is built around its archeological treasures. Catriona realizes this when she roams around the cobblestone streets of the city. With every monument she visits, she finds herself transported to a different era, right from Perperikon fort, which narrate stories of the Byzantine empire, to Boyana church, which is home to some of the earliest examples of medieval artwork.

In Hydrofoil Big Air, the battle for the world title is a close-run thing....

programme.sub-title: S08 : E02 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 2, Holland Part 1
programme.desc: We are here in Doetinchem – Holland, for Stage 2 and 3 in the hottest day of the year. 40-degree heat, these boys have to work harder than they ever have. The sun is going to be beating down, they’re going to be sweating, hydration is going to be key today. I also reckon they’re all going to be wearing their sunglasses. Let’s see which shady looking character wins.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E03 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 3, Holland Part 2
programme.desc: So there you have it. The next day, 3 more events in 40 Degrees heat. We’ve got Gavin coming into day 2 leading the pack. Kelvin De Ruiter our world champion struggling a little bit at the moment, but Yoke Race, Conan’s Wheel and then Stones to finish. There is a lot to be played for here, so stay tuned to see if Gavin can take the lead and beat Kelvin overall.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E04 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 4, Serbia Part 1
programme.desc: We’re in the Serbian city of Novi kozarci, for the next stage in the world series. And what a fantastic line up we have for you again. But it is going to be one of the hottest stages yet. A Strongman competition in 44-degree heat. It will be a real challenge for these athletes to finish this event. From all over the world the strongmen came here for the title! Welcome to the heat hell in Serbia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E05 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 5, Serbia Part 2
programme.desc: Welcome to day 2 in Serbia, and its another baking hot one. We are in Kikinda today! We’ve got three more gruelling events for our athletes. Sami Ahola is leading the pack, so can he be the first Finnish athlete to take an SCL title. Stay tuned to find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E06 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 6, Joensuu Part 1
programme.desc: In this competition, we have our athletes paired up. They’re going to have to take on each event together, having to factor in each other’s strengths and possibly weaknesses. Can the men who normally work alone, share their powers as a duo? Let’s find out!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E07 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 7, Joensuu Part 2
programme.desc: Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland- Joensuu. Welcome to the final day of the world’s strongest team event. The race to be the best team in the world is coming to its crowing point. All is still wide open for any of these to take the title. Who is going to win? Will team Latvia keep their World Title or maybe Finland can attach them? Keep watching and we’ll find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Stage 10 of the Strongman Champions League 2025 arrives in Gdańsk, Poland, where a world-class lineup competes in tough events including deadlift, log lift, and loading race. With top athletes like Aivars Smaukstelis and Adam Roszkowski in action, the battle intensifies as the season nears its climax.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E08 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 8, Esposende
programme.desc: Welcome back to Strongman Champions League for another stage of the 2022 world tour. We’re in Esposende - Portugal in this beautiful setting next to the beach in front of a packed crowd with some of the strongest men the world has to offer. With a real Porsche deadlift and many other crazy stuff. So, lets get this show started.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E09 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 9, Great Britain
programme.desc: Hello and welcome in Gloucester, UK. The world tour hasn’t been here for what feels like forever. And now for the first time in the Mekka of Strongman, the SCL World series will crown a great Champion with the SCL Title. It will be full with special wooden events, and a great winner! So ladies and gentleman, boys and girls, brace yourselves because I present to you strongman champions league UK.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E10 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 10, Poland Part 1
programme.desc: We are in Sopot, Poland the home of Legends Mariusz Pudzianowkski and Krzystof Radzikowski. Who will grab the title here in holiday resort Sopot, on the great Balrtic Sea with 6 events and 12 athlets in the mix!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E11 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 11, Poland Part 2
programme.desc: We are in Sopot, Poland, after 3 events the Polish Strongman Oskar Ziolkowski is Leading. Kelvin, Travis and Aivars are coming up and will try to beat him, but will Oskar take his first title ever?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E12 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 12, Bosnia
programme.desc: it’s been a long time since the world series held a championship here in Sarajevo. Let’s see what test of strength this destination holds for our athletes. And what fantastic athletes are here again in Stage 12 of the SCL World Series. The strongman champions league Bosnia is another iconic Strongman event with the return of Rongo Keen from Australia and Portugal winner 2022 George Sulaiman.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E13 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 13, Romania
programme.desc: Welcome to Sibiu in Romania. It’s an important day for some of these athletes, because four of them have a real chance of getting into our all-exclusive world finals. There’s only one more stage after this to get those all-important extra points. So, there’s going to be some fireworks, who will take the title here and who will qualify for the World Finals?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E14 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 14, Gibraltar
programme.desc: This is it the last show before the world final. These guys have really got to fight for the points now, this is going to be action packed, whilst these guys fight it out all day.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E15 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 15, Turkey Part 1
programme.desc: We are in Alanya, on Turkey’s south-coast for the final stop at the end of a mammoth season of Strongman Champions League. Here in the sunshine, we’ll finally crown our world champion and what a place Alanya is. You could not ask for a better setting. After months of hard-work, if not years for some of these lads, we find out who will take the world title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E16 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 16, Turkey Part 1
programme.desc: Welcome, to day two of the strongman champions league 2022 finals here in Alanya, Turkey. It’s all up for grabs now, everyone is fighting for the world title belt. This is an epic episode where we finally crown the World champion of 2022.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E01 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 1 - Finland
programme.desc: Welcome to the 2023 Strongman Champions League in Vaasa, Finland! This year’s event introduces a knockout format with 6 intense events over 90 minutes, ending in a unique deadlift face-off with boats.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E02 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 2 - Serbia
programme.desc: Stage 2 of the Strongman Champions League 2023 is set in Zrenjanin, Serbia. This exciting event features 5 challenging contests, including a superhuman Yoke race. As the SCL World Series Tour continues, athletes will battle it out to claim the yellow leader’s position for the season. Don’t miss this incredible stage of strength and endurance!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E03 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 3 - Finland Teams World
programme.desc: The World’s Strongest Team will be crowned in this edition of SCL, here in Kalajoki-Finland we’ve picked some of the best in the business, teamed them up, and they’ll be going all out against each other. It’s now no longer about being a lonely wolf, but more about the pack mentality. It is a competition over 7 events, including a Big 2-man Log lift and heavy deadlift. Let’s start the action.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E04 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 4 - Holland
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League in Holland at the Dru Factory in ULFT. A great location for a spectacular battle with 14 Athletes over 3 events! The first 3 events in this episode are Truckpull/ Superyoke and Farmerswalk, with 2 massive logs of 150 kg in their hands. So, join us for the show of strength, the place of power, it’s the circus of the extreme.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E05 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 5 - Holland 2023
programme.desc: Ladies and gentleman, boys and girls, strongman fans across the world, we are back for SCL Holland part two. Get ready because it’s about to get heavy. The Strongman Champions League in Holland, continues with the last 3 events, here at the Dru Factory in ULFT. The events in this episode are the Viking Press, Wheel Flip and the Atlas Stones, with 180 kg in the end.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E06 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 6 - World's Strongest Latino
programme.desc: For the first time ever, the World’s Strongest Latino competition has begun. This two-day event in Porto, Portugal, features 20 athletes from around the world competing in 8 events. After 4 grueling events, the top 12 will advance to the finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E07 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 7 - Finland World Record Breakers
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League World Record Breakers 2023 starts with a 25-ton snow plow! Crazy machines are pulled and pushed, with many kilograms moved. A few new world records are set in this competition.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E08 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 8 - Portugal
programme.desc: We have returned to the powerhouse of Portugal for an edge-of-your-seat galactic battle. If all the planets collided at once, it wouldn’t compare to the bang of this show. Get ready for the battle of the beasts; it’s the heaviest show in the universe, the Strongman Champions League.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E09 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 9 - England
programme.desc: SCL UK has landed in Gloucester it is workout war fitness for the ferocious, it’s going to be a a battle of the brutal, a rampage of the roofless. This is going to be a massacre of the muscles. You know it by now, but just in case you don’t, this is strongman champions league.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E10 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 10 - World's Strongest Viking
programme.desc: On the menu this week it’s medieval madness, we’ve come back to the middle ages to test our noble men through a muscle gaining of events. They are hoping and we are hoping that one will survive to take the title of the world’s strongest Viking. The official World's Strongest Viking is this time in Finland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This week is a good one, can you feel the energy? Sit still, just look at me and try and feel the energy, because I can tell you, the atmosphere here is electric, it’s explosive, there is a pure elemental force going through these athletes' veins. I’m shaking because it’s Poland, it’s powerful, it’s strongman champions league, and you know what I'm going to say, get ready because it’s about to get heavy.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL Poland part 2 - Who will win the title in Poland and take 25 points for the world ranking. It is very exciting on the top, in part 1 between Poland and Latvia. Another great episode with super strongman events such as: Bag Toss Medley, Log Lift Reps and the Powerstairs. Also an interview with Mateusz Kieloszkowski, the all time favorite champion from Poland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: It’s time to show our strength and gain respect from the gods of Olympus. Our gladiators have many events set out by no other than Hercules himself. The coliseum is ready here on this mythological island of Cyprus, so we have landed in Limassol were again 12 Top Strongmen are battling for the title and ranking points.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E14 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 14 - South Africa
programme.desc: The only and official world championship Truckpulling for its 10th year, again at the Strongman Champions league. With the 3 times Worldchampion Kelvin de Ruiter – defending his title. This championship has trucks in all shapes and sizes which is a lot like our athletes, there all different pay loads, but does the biggest win or is it the strongest.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E15 Stage 15 - SCL World Finals Bosnia
programme.desc: Years and years of determination has brought us here today, when all the walls felt like they were caving in perseverance. When their bodies were screaming, hurting, shouting stop, beneath. These are the things which make up a man, these are the things that bring you world finalists. This episode they fight for the greatest title of all, they fight to put their names in the history books forever.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League heads to Siófok, Hungary, by Lake Balaton for a crucial late-season showdown. Reigning champion Adam Roszkowski returns to defend his title against a stacked field, including Aivars Smaukstelis and Evans Nana. With World Finals approaching, the battle for points intensifies.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E16 Stage 16 - SCL World Finals Bosnia
programme.desc: Part 2 of the World Finals of the Strongman Champions League tour 2023 at the Sarajevo Centar Skenderija in Bosnia. 3 Events was done already and amazing results have been set. Who will be the new World champion? Find out here, who, after 16 stages, will be crowned World Champion 2023.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After 10 years there is another edition of THE ICEMAN in minus 25 degrees and snow, and it is also the first stage in the MLO Strongman Champions League. With a new World champion from South Africa, Rayno Nel, it will be a challenging year for all the athletes to win the title again after 1 full year. But now they can win one very exceptional title, which is the SCL ICEMAN!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A battle in the beautiful Caribbean Islands. Over 2 days and more than 10,000 spectators expected like previous editions. The cold temperature from the Iceman is changed in 35 degrees hot Martinique. Watch who gets the title in Martinique, events include: Truck Pull, Deadlift, Hercules Hold, Log Lift, and Arm Over Arm Pull.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The SCL Hungary this year is in the AQUAPARK in Budapest, Stage 3 from the spectacular MLO Strongman Champions League, World is Biggest Pro League. With five great events, such as: Viking Press, Farmer's Walk, Deadlift, Conan's Wheel, and A loading race with Beer barrels of 200 Kg. It is a must see!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We're in Zrenjanin, Serbia, again a fantastic stage in the SCL WORLD SERIES TOUR 2024, five events including a super human Yoke race. Who will be the yellow leader for the coming season and take the title with 25 championship points?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We're in Groenlo, east of Holland With the new Talent from South Africa and 2025 Strongest Man of the World - Rayno Nel. The first 3 events are Truckpull, Log Lift and Loading race. So, join us for the show of strength, the place of power, it is the circus of the extreme.

programme.sub-title: S01 : E07 Mercedes SLS vs Audi R8
programme.desc: Mylene Gomera and Saif Hattawi once again invite the owners of the most extraordinary cars to Dubai, where they award points for speed, style and sound. This time, they will be joined by a limited edition Mercedes SLS and an Audi R8.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: The roaring sounds of engines and exhausts usually dominate the Nuerburgring, but we focused on something a bit quieter this time. How about taking part in a 15 mile bike ride around the ring, or perhaps a 16 mile run?

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: In this episode, we focused on Phoenix Racing, the successful team from the Eifel Region that rocked the DTM.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: The Fiat Dino Spider is one of the most beautiful cabriolets of the 1960s. Its impeccable design was created by Pininfarina, and only 525 units were built. Under its hood growls a Ferrari V6 engine.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: French manufacturers have also built milestones in automotive history in the past, including lesser-known brands such as Delage and Talbot, but also vehicles from Peugeot, Renault and Citroen.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: We took a look at Audi's latest generation of TDI engines and their RS5 TDI Concept. In addition we compared the advantages and disadvantages of the two main fossil fuels for cars, gasoline and diesel. And: the 2014 Porsche Cayenne Diesel.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: The Mercedes-AMG E63 S is a wolf in sheep's clothing. This station wagon has more power than the Nissan GTR 'Godzilla'. Also: the Porsche Panamera GTS feels at home on the motorway and on the race track. And: Audi's powerful all-purpose executive car RS6.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: McLaren's MP4 12C GT3 is as fast as a Formula One car. We explored how this super sports car came to be. Also: the German company Mechatronik specializes in restoring rare and classic cars like the Mercedes W111.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.sub-title: S01 : E74 Supercars of the Frankfurt Motor Show
programme.desc: We took a look at the IAA Frankfurt 2011 highlights, like the new Porsche 911, Mercedes' SLS AMG Roadster, the Bentley Continental Convertible, a 1,100 hp monster from Croatia and others.

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: The Stunt Heroes face a new mission: performing a front-flip through the air with a stuntman behind the wheel of an estate wagon. Stuntmen Daniel and Lars display a brilliant fight choreography in some spectacular driving scenes.

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: Stuntman Tobi operates an Artega GT at full speed via remote control. This is just a warm-up before the big stunt, in which he drives a car up a steep ramp at 68 mph. The question is: How high can remote-controlled cars fly?

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: Christian Menzel asked our presenter Miriam to participate in a driver safety training where he showed tips and tricks on what to do in emergency situations.

programme.title: Trackmasters

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The Ferrari Four, also called Ferrari FF, is the first four-wheel family car from Maranello. Also: the BMW M5 shines both as a family and business car. And: the Mercedes-Benz SL is a roadster drivers' dream.

programme.title: Rzeka Złoczyńców
